capture_note: compiler-form SQL rendered offline with the project venv (no DB connection); same compiler other domains pair with CaptureQueriesContext executed SQL. Row shapes follow serialize_event/message_envelope key sets.

next_event_seq.shape: MAX(seq) over thread events + 1 (0 when empty)
next_event_seq.sql: SELECT "assistant_event"."thread_id", MAX("assistant_event"."seq") AS "m" FROM "assistant_event" WHERE "assistant_event"."thread_id" = 33ade466-0600-43ed-b19a-9616ba72e19b GROUP BY "assistant_event"."thread_id"

next_message_seq.shape: MAX(seq) over thread messages + 1 (0 when empty)
next_message_seq.sql: SELECT "assistant_message"."thread_id", MAX("assistant_message"."seq") AS "m" FROM "assistant_message" WHERE "assistant_message"."thread_id" = 33ade466-0600-43ed-b19a-9616ba72e19b GROUP BY "assistant_message"."thread_id"

append_event.shape: atomic: SELECT thread FOR UPDATE, INSERT event (kind truncated to 64 chars), publish on commit
append_event.concurrency: seq allocated MAX+1 under a row lock on the thread so streaming handler + threadpool tools do not collide (events.py:9-11)

create_message.shape: atomic: SELECT thread FOR UPDATE, INSERT message with MAX+1 seq

prune_turn_deltas.shape: DELETE assistant_event WHERE turn_id AND kind='assistant_delta'

publish.shape: PUBLISH <channel> <serialize_event JSON>; redis-unavailable -> log + return (never raises)

load_history.shape: newest N COMPLETED turns with non-null model_messages (order -created_at,-id, slice, reverse to chronological); per-blob ModelMessagesTypeAdapter.validate_python, skip-on-error
load_history.sql: SELECT "assistant_turn"."model_messages" FROM "assistant_turn" WHERE ("assistant_turn"."thread_id" = 33ade466-0600-43ed-b19a-9616ba72e19b AND "assistant_turn"."model_messages" IS NOT NULL AND "assistant_turn"."status" = completed) ORDER BY "assistant_turn"."created_at" DESC, "assistant_turn"."id" DESC LIMIT 40

load_context_turn.sql: SELECT "assistant_turn"."id", "assistant_turn"."thread_id", "assistant_turn"."user_message_id", "assistant_turn"."status", "assistant_turn"."model_messages", "assistant_turn"."usage", "assistant_turn"."model_used", "assistant_turn"."error_code", "assistant_turn"."error_detail", "assistant_turn"."created_at", "assistant_turn"."started_at", "assistant_turn"."completed_at", "assistant_thread"."id", "assistant_thread"."workspace_id", "assistant_thread"."user_id", "assistant_thread"."title", "assistant_thread"."kind", "assistant_thread"."is_archived", "assistant_thread"."active_turn_id", "assistant_thread"."created_at", "assistant_thread"."updated_at", "workspaces"."created_at", "workspaces"."updated_at", "workspaces"."created_by_id", "workspaces"."updated_by_id", "workspaces"."deleted_at", "workspaces"."id", "workspaces"."name", "workspaces"."logo", "workspaces"."logo_asset_id", "workspaces"."owner_id", "workspaces"."slug", "workspaces"."organization_size", "workspaces"."timezone", "workspaces"."background_color", "assistant_message"."id", "assistant_message"."thread_id", "assistant_message"."turn_id", "assistant_message"."seq", "assistant_message"."kind", "assistant_message"."display_content", "assistant_message"."payload", "assistant_message"."status", "assistant_message"."created_at", "assistant_message"."completed_at" FROM "assistant_turn" INNER JOIN "assistant_thread" ON ("assistant_turn"."thread_id" = "assistant_thread"."id") INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("assistant_thread"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") LEFT OUTER JOIN "assistant_message" ON ("assistant_turn"."user_message_id" = "assistant_message"."id") WHERE "assistant_turn"."id" = 0b01261f-8567-4e72-aad4-d4436a6a0ac7 ORDER BY "assistant_turn"."created_at" ASC

sweep_running_ids.sql: SELECT "assistant_turn"."id" FROM "assistant_turn" WHERE "assistant_turn"."status" = running ORDER BY "assistant_turn"."created_at" ASC

owned_thread.sql: SELECT "assistant_thread"."id", "assistant_thread"."workspace_id", "assistant_thread"."user_id", "assistant_thread"."title", "assistant_thread"."kind", "assistant_thread"."is_archived", "assistant_thread"."active_turn_id", "assistant_thread"."created_at", "assistant_thread"."updated_at" FROM "assistant_thread" INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("assistant_thread"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") WHERE ("assistant_thread"."id" = db68f428-df63-4de8-b060-2d4038a5b1f4 AND "assistant_thread"."user_id" = a7107351-38ac-4f3d-91d5-ee34c2459bd6 AND "workspaces"."slug" = acme) ORDER BY "assistant_thread"."updated_at" DESC

thread_message_count.sql: SELECT "assistant_message"."id", "assistant_message"."thread_id", "assistant_message"."turn_id", "assistant_message"."seq", "assistant_message"."kind", "assistant_message"."display_content", "assistant_message"."payload", "assistant_message"."status", "assistant_message"."created_at", "assistant_message"."completed_at" FROM "assistant_message" WHERE "assistant_message"."thread_id" = 33ade466-0600-43ed-b19a-9616ba72e19b ORDER BY "assistant_message"."seq" ASC

message_list_window.sql: SELECT "assistant_message"."id", "assistant_message"."thread_id", "assistant_message"."turn_id", "assistant_message"."seq", "assistant_message"."kind", "assistant_message"."display_content", "assistant_message"."payload", "assistant_message"."status", "assistant_message"."created_at", "assistant_message"."completed_at" FROM "assistant_message" WHERE "assistant_message"."thread_id" = 33ade466-0600-43ed-b19a-9616ba72e19b ORDER BY "assistant_message"."seq" ASC

events_replay_window.sql: SELECT "assistant_event"."id", "assistant_event"."thread_id", "assistant_event"."turn_id", "assistant_event"."seq", "assistant_event"."kind", "assistant_event"."message_id", "assistant_event"."payload", "assistant_event"."created_at" FROM "assistant_event" WHERE ("assistant_event"."seq" > 5 AND "assistant_event"."thread_id" = 33ade466-0600-43ed-b19a-9616ba72e19b) ORDER BY "assistant_event"."seq" ASC

threads_list.sql: SELECT "assistant_thread"."id", "assistant_thread"."workspace_id", "assistant_thread"."user_id", "assistant_thread"."title", "assistant_thread"."kind", "assistant_thread"."is_archived", "assistant_thread"."active_turn_id", "assistant_thread"."created_at", "assistant_thread"."updated_at" FROM "assistant_thread" INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("assistant_thread"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") WHERE ("assistant_thread"."kind" = chat AND "assistant_thread"."user_id" = 88d57e9a-1254-45c2-a79c-58ccb38aa150 AND "workspaces"."slug" = acme) ORDER BY "assistant_thread"."updated_at" DESC

mcp_enabled_list.sql: SELECT "assistant_mcp_server"."id", "assistant_mcp_server"."user_id", "assistant_mcp_server"."name", "assistant_mcp_server"."url", "assistant_mcp_server"."auth_header_encrypted", "assistant_mcp_server"."is_enabled", "assistant_mcp_server"."created_at", "assistant_mcp_server"."updated_at" FROM "assistant_mcp_server" WHERE ("assistant_mcp_server"."is_enabled" AND "assistant_mcp_server"."user_id" = a8bdb207-e389-45bd-b335-5c9651a1ac02) ORDER BY "assistant_mcp_server"."created_at" ASC

updates.name: mark_running QUEUED->RUNNING
updates.shape: UPDATE assistant_turn SET status=running, started_at=now WHERE id AND status=queued; 0 rows -> False

updates.name: complete_turn
updates.shape: SELECT turn FOR UPDATE; set completed/model_messages/usage/model_used/completed_at; clear thread.active_turn when it matches

updates.name: fail_turn
updates.shape: SELECT turn FOR UPDATE; set failed + error_code[:64] + error_detail[:2000]; close streaming rows as failed; clear active_turn; INSERT error message row + turn_failed event

updates.name: cancel_turn
updates.shape: SELECT turn FOR UPDATE; set cancelled; close streaming rows as cancelled; clear active_turn; INSERT turn_cancelled event

updates.name: finalize_open_rows
updates.shape: UPDATE assistant_message SET status, completed_at=now WHERE turn AND status=streaming
